# Brew log

A made-up skill that exists only as a test fixture for the skill benchmark. It is harmless and
teaches nothing about real work.

## Rules

- Open with the water temperature and the steep time.
- Name the tea or coffee and the amount used.
- Keep the entry to three sentences or fewer.
- Define any abbreviation the first time it appears.
- Say what to change the next time.
- Write the date as year, month, day.
